Test: 'a hypothesis already held on evidence from a source that is then quarantined loses that evidence's support and is revised below the action bar in the same pass' (qip-kernel tests/source_lifecycle.rs). Mutation: skip the held-thesis revise loop; the test must then fail. The row stays PARTIAL on the default-path item.

rows.reason: Each clause is met on a default path or guarded on its only path. qip-edge cell.rs::mark_unreliable and apply_snapshot run in Cell::work on every qip-edge-node pass. They mark the book unreliable, request a snapshot, and quarantine its features through qip-feature-dag engine.rs::quarantine (:235) until the snapshot rebuilds the book. Training: the only microstructure training path is qip-training microstructure::build_examples (whose only caller is the tick desk), and it refuses unreliable spans. Replay: qip-simulation-engine tick_replay.rs applies no book edit inside an open unreliable span until a reset (:886). So under bar part 3 a contaminated window cannot enter training or replay without the guard. The kernel and world-model feature stores are fed by the centre's own ingestion: market-ingestion's depth adapter rebuilds on a gap and withholds a diverged book. They are not fed by the cell's books, so nothing derived from an unreliable cell book reaches them.

rows.reason: There is a real hole in the capture path. qip-sequencing capture.rs::CaptureStream::capture, which qip-edge-node event_fabric/drain.rs:820 uses for the Tick Lake, keeps event.uncertainty() only before the clock discipline converges (:126-139). After that, Placed::from_disciplined stores the discipline's own estimate, which can be narrower than the uncertainty Cell::clock_uncertainty widened. The lake record then under-states the error that qip-training ClockPrecision reads in the tick desk, so an imprecise window can pass the label and promotion gate. The rest of the clause is met. The cell-side ordering pause (GATE_CLOCK_SKEW, pauses_cross_venue_ordering) runs on the default edge path. ReplayRun's only consumers are the gated tick desk and qip-cli simulate, which promotes nothing.
rows.closure: In CaptureStream::capture, place each event with max(the disciplined estimate, event.uncertainty()), so a widened uncertainty is never narrowed in storage. Test: 'an event the cell captured while its clock row read stale keeps its widened uncertainty in the lake record after the stream's discipline has converged' (qip-sequencing tests). Mutation: use the disciplined estimate alone; the test must then fail.
